verses.text: Ob'iltak chonhab' Samaria, niwan yelk'och t'a yol sat heb' uk'um anh t'a yol yik Efraín. Yelwanub' yaj t'a jun ak'lik yax sat. Lajan pax icha korona xumaktak wan stakji t'a sjolom heb' toxo ix te cham yuj anh anh. Ha heb' kajan t'a Samaria chi', anhej uk'el anh syak' heb'.

Ha Jehová ix sik'anel jun winh winak te tek'an, te jelan t'a owal. Ol jawok winh yet' yip, icha yaxnhab' kalan yet' k'een sakb'at. Ol jawok winh icha chakxuxum ik' smak'an chaanh tastak, icha pax yik syak'an yowal ha' b'eyuma' yik tz'el ha' b'aj sb'eyi. Yuj yip winh chi', ol em lanhnaj chonhab' Samaria chi'.
Ha jun chonhab' niwan yelk'och t'a heb' uk'um anh chi', ol stek'em jun winh ay yip chi'.

Ha jun chonhab' ay t'a panhan te yax sat wach' yilji chi', haton jun lajan icha junok takinh korona chi', ol satjokelok. Icha wal sat te' higo spet eluli, elanhchamel slojib'at yuj junok mach tz'ilani, icha chi' ol aj jun chonhab' chi'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, icha junok korona te wach' yilji, icha chi' ol aj t'a heb' anima olto kan t'a schonhab'. Icha stzalaj junok mach yet' skorona, icha chi' ol aj stzalaj heb' yet' Jehová.
Ha Jehová chi' ol ak'an sna heb' juez yik wach' ol yutok heb' sch'olb'itan yaj heb' anima. Ol yak' pax yip heb' soldado yik stanhwan schonhab'.

Ha heb' winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh schekab' Dios, tzek' ch'umch'on heb' winh uk'el anh, skistalax heb' winh yuj yowal anh chi'. Ayik sk'e anh t'a sjolom heb' winh schekab' Dios chi', skomon naank'e heb' winh yalanel slolonel Dios, haxo heb' winh sakerdote chi', max sb'olaj yaj heb' anima heb' winh t'a stojolal.
Masanil smexa heb' winh miktak sat, xejtak sat yuj heb' winh, manhxa jab'ok sat smexa heb' winh chi' wach'.
Syalan heb' anima wuj a in tik: ¿Mach snib'ej jun winak tik sk'ayb'ej? ¿A am t'a heb' wanto yel t'a yim, haton heb' maxtzak chuni?
¿Tas yuj jab'jab'il yalan winh t'ayonh, icha swulwon heb' unin wanto yel sti'? xchi heb'.
Tato malaj snib'ej heb' yab'ani, ha Dios ol ak'lab'an heb' ch'ok nakional yalan t'a heb', ichato tonhej ol wulwon heb' ol yab' heb'.
Haton t'a heb' b'uchwajnak chi' alb'il icha tik: Ina wal ik'oj ip tik, yik'okab' yip heb' k'unb'inak, siklab'okab' sk'ol heb', xchi Jehová, palta maj schalaj yab' heb'.

Yuj chi', a slolonel Jehová ol alchaj t'a heb' t'a jab'jab'il icha swulwon heb' unin wanto yel sti'. Yuj chi', ayik ol b'eyek' heb' pak'jab' ol aj stelwi heb', ol echnaj heb', ol kan heb' t'a yaal, ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a ch'ok nakional.
Ex yajal eyaj t'a Jerusalén tik, ex b'uchumtak, ab'ek wal slolonel Jehová:

Yujto ix eyal icha tik: Ay ko lajti' yet' yajalil chamel, yuj chi' ayik ol jawok tas ol onh satanelok icha ha' eluma', malaj tas ol onh ik'anok, yujto a juntzanh lolonel es ix kak'och yipok ko k'ool, ol ko kol ko b'a t'ay, xe chi.

Yuj chi', a Jehová Yajal tz'alan icha tik: Ol wak'em junok mach yipumalok Sion. Ha jun chi' sik'b'ilel wuuj, malaj b'ak'uinh ol satelok, te niwan yelk'ochi, lajan icha junok k'een k'een tz'emkan t'a yeskinail junok pat. Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch yipok sk'ool, malaj b'ak'uinh ol kan heb' t'a q'uixwelal.

Ha t'a Sion chi', ol wak'lab'ej in tojolal icha tz'ajem ch'anh kuerda, ma plomo yik yechel pat, xchi Jehová chi'. Palta a es ix eyak'och yipok he k'ool chi', a k'een sakb'at ol satanelok. Haxo b'aj tze kol he b'a chi', ha ha' eluma' ol kuchanb'atok.
Ha he lajti' ix eyak' yet' yajalil chamel chi', ol satelok. Ayik ol ja jun icha eluma' t'a eyib'anh chi', ol ex kan t'a yalanh yuj.
Ayik ol jawok t'a juntak el, ol ex kuchjokb'at yuj. Junjun q'uinhib'alil, ma k'ual t'ak'wal ol ja t'ayex. Ayik ol eyab'an yab'ixal jun chi', ol ex ib'xokk'eok.
Lajan ol ex aj icha junok mach sway t'a junok ch'at tzapan steel yet' junok k'u' lot'an sat.
Icha yutejnak Jehová yak'an owal t'a lum switzal Perazim yet' t'a lum yak'likal Gabaón, icha chi' ol yutok sk'ulan junok tas satub'tak, junok tas manh tanhwab'ilok eyuuj.
Ha tiknaik jun, manh ex b'uchwajok, yik wach' max niwtaj eyaelal. Ix wab' tas ix yal Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil. Toxo ix sna'a to ol satel masanil smakb'en jun chonhab' tik.
Maklejek eyab' tas ol wala', scham wal eyab'an in lolonel:
Ha junok winh sb'oan smunlajel yik tz'awwi, manhoknhej t'okoj lum syak' winh yet' k'een arado, manh tonhejok pax ste chok'b'itej lum winh yet' k'een rastrillo.
Ayik toxo ix b'o lu'um, syawan yinhatil anh eneldo winh yet' anh komino, syawan pax ixim trigo winh t'a stzolal. Haxo t'a stitak syawej ixim kebada winh yet' ixim awena, icha b'aj smoj yawchaji.
Ha Dios tz'ak'an nachajel yuj winh tas tz'aj smunlaji.

Yujto a anh eneldo chi', max tek'chaj anh, max ek' pax junok karreta t'a yib'anh anh komino chi'. Tonhej smak'jiel anh eneldo chi' yet' junok te te', haxo anh komino chi', smak'chaj anh yet' junok te' jixk'ab' te'.
Ha ixim trigo stek'ji ixim, syal yek' junok karreta t'a yib'anh ixim, palta tato hanheja' yek' te' t'a yib'anh ixim, spoj ixim sat chi'.
Icha chi' syutej Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil snaan tas ol sk'ulej. Satub'tak yilji tas nab'il yuj, tz'elnhejk'och yuj sjelanil.
